    Kia Seltos

    4.5
    User Rating (233)

    This generation of the Kia Seltos gets boxier, with more aggressive SUV-esque proportions. It truly shines inside with its soft-touch materials, an upmarket cabin, and dual infotainment screens housed in a modern dashboard. The 1.5-litre turbo-petrol version (making 158bhp and 253Nm) was tested by Carwale, it felt smooth and responsive, while the DCT transmission performed superbly in traffic.

    Kia Seltos price starts from Rs. 11.25 Lakh for base model and goes upto Rs. 22.02 Lakh (ex-showroom) for top model as of November 2026.

    • Base Variant (HTE) : Rs. 11.25 Lakh - Rs. 12.94 Lakh (ex-showroom)

    Why Buy Kia Seltos?

    • Highlights
    • Walkthrough
    • Highlights
    • Walkthrough
    The dual-12.3-inch infotainment displays are housed in a single panoramic panel.
    New Seltos can be had with 16, 17, and 18-inch wheels and five alloy options (based on variant choice).
    It gets 447-litres of boot space, which can be expanded by folding the rear seats.
    The Kia Seltos 2026 gets six airbags as standard.
    The new Seltos 2026 is 95mm longer (at 4460mm), 30mm wider (at 1830mm) and has an 80mm bigger wheelbase (at 2690mm).
    The Seltos features an aggressive grille, along with unique DRLs and LED headlamps that give it a striking road presence.
    The Star Map LED connected tail lamps and sporty spoiler define its futuristic identity, inspired by Kia’s EV lineup.
    The dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with light, enhancing the premium ambience and providing an expansive view for all occupants.
    Tucked away for emergencies, the steel spare wheel either gets a 205/65 R16 or 215/60 R17 tyre, depending on the variant.
    With a 447-litre capacity, the boot remains a strong point with adequate space for luggage, maintaining the Seltos' practical appeal.
    The second row seats are comfortable for long journeys, has sunblinds, but the dark interior theme can limit the sense of airiness.
    It features power adjustments with memory, upmarket mesh headrests, and also hard plastic seatbacks.
    Part of the seamless panoramic display, the digital cluster includes a Blind View Monitor for safer, more tech-forward navigation.
    Driving in tight spaces and difficult situations is effortless with a 360-degree camera and blind view monitor for driver awareness.
    The refined cockpit layout places key controls at your fingertips, ensuring a driver-centric experience that feels premium and well-integrated.
    The clean, premium cabin features a Trinity Panoramic Display and soft-touch materials; build quality feels solid and significantly improved.
    Integrated within the clean dashboard design, the climate system provides intuitive comfort and includes dedicated rear vents.
    Paired with a smooth gearboxes, the shifter manages traffic effortlessly, providing a stress-free driving experience.

    Kia Seltos Variants

    Kia Seltos On-road price for the base model, HTE, starts at Rs. 13.38 Lakh, the popular model, HTE (O), is priced at Rs. 14.75 Lakh, and the top model, X-Line (O), goes up to Rs. 26.45 Lakh.

    Kia Seltos Price for Popular Variants

    At Rs. 13.38 Lakh, the base model Kia Seltos HTE offers Ice Cube LED headlamps, a 10.25-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and cruise control. The popular model Kia Seltos HTE(O) provides key additional features like connected LED taillights, 60:40 split rear seats and (on automatics) an electronic parking brake with auto-hold. The top model Kia Seltos X-Line(O) gets Level 2 ADAS with 21 features, a 360-degree camera and ventilated front seats. Seltos is offered in Petrol and Diesel with manual, automatic and iMT options.

    How is the Kia Seltos car?

    • Pros

      • The interior quality, material finish, and overall cabin ambience feel genuinely premium.
      • The turbo-petrol engine delivers strong performance with smooth, refined power delivery.
      • The DCT automatic gearbox is quick-shifting, smooth in traffic, and easy to live with.
      • High-end features like a large panoramic sunroof, digital displays and sun-blinds enhance comfort.
      • Ride quality has improved over the previous model, with better bump absorption.

    • Cons

      • The diesel powertrain could use more high-speed grunt.
      • Despite improvements, the ride quality is still on the firmer side in the segment.
      • The turbo-petrol engine isn’t very fuel-efficient, especially in city driving conditions.
      • Some hard plastic elements feel out of place in an otherwise premium cabin.

    Kia Seltos Powertrain, Performance, and Range

    4.4
    User Rating (233)
    • Petrol 1.5L Turbo
    • Petrol 1.5L
    • Diesel 1.5L Turbo
    • The Seltos is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder turbo-petrol engine that makes 158bhp and 253Nm.
    • It can be had with either a six-speed clutchless manual (IMT) or a seven-speed DCT automatic gearbox, we reviewed the DCT version.
    • The powertrain is competent, delivering strong performance irrespective of whether it's being driven in cities or on highways.
    • The power delivery remains smooth with a tinge of eagerness that can bring a smile to an enthusiast's face.
    • The DCT gearbox also manages shifts nicely, working with finesse during everyday usage, including bumper-to-bumper traffic.
    • The suspension setup in the new Seltos has also leaned a bit towards plushness, but the improvement is not a major one.
    • It manages sharp bumps and uneven roads better, but it's still far from the most absorbent SUVs in the segment.
    • It gets three drive modes (Eco, Normal, Sport) and terrain modes (Sand, Mud, Snow) for further personalisation of the driving experience.

    Kia Seltos Key Specifications:

    • This engine configuration can be had with a six-speed manual or CVT automatic (dubbed IVT by Kia) gearbox options.
    • This front wheel drive SUV gets paddle shifters in the CVT version.

    • This FWD drivetrain is mated to a six-speed manual or automatic (torque converter) transmission options.

    Kia Seltos Ride, Handling, and Braking

    • The ride quality is softer than the outgoing model, it's plusher and more absorbent, thanks to the tweaked suspension setup.
    • During our real-world tests, the changes are noticeable, and the ride feels more compliant, but the improvements are not significant.
    • It handles sharp bumps and layered road surfaces better. It's not the most comfortable car in the segment, but it no longer feels crashy on bad patches of road.
    Read More

    Kia Seltos Design and Build Quality

    4.7
    User Rating (233)
    • The new Kia Seltos sports a completely new front including a muscular grille with vertical slats (dubbed 'digital tiger' by Kia), and ice cube LED projector headlamps, while the rear features a 'star map' LED tail lights.
    • It features Kia's distinct vertical LEDs and a cleaner split headlight; a similar design approach can be spotted towards the rear as well.
    • From the sides, its smoother lines, blacked-out pillars, roof rails, and a pronounced rear spoiler can be seen. The LEDs at the front also extend quite a bit to the sides along the edge of its bonnet.
    • Five alloy design options are available, but limited to the corresponding wheel size (16-inch, 17-inch and 18-inch).
    • The new Kia Seltos has a length of 4460mm (95mm longer), a width of 1830mm (30mm wider) and a wheelbase of 2690mm (80mm bigger), which could translate into a more spacious cabin.
    • Ten monotone colour options are available in Morning Haze (New), Magma Red (New), Frost Blue (New), Ivory Silver Gloss (New), Pewter Olive, Xclusive Matte Graphite, Glacier White Pearl, Aurora Black Pearl, Gravity Grey, and Imperial Blue. Two dual-tone options are Glacier White Pearl/Aurora Black Pearl and Magma Red/Aurora Black Pearl.
    Read More

    Kia Seltos Features and Equipment

    4.7
    User Rating (233)
    • The new Kia Seltos features a dual 12.3-inch display housed in a single panel, dubbed Trinity Panoramic Display by Kia.
    • It gets an 8-speaker BOSE sound system, 64-colour ambient colours, wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, and Kia Connect 2.0 for seamless OTA updates and diagnostics.
    • Interior comforts include leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control, wireless charging pads, and USB ports for device charging.
    • It also comes equipped with a 10-way power-adjustable driver’s seat and ventilated seats in the front row.
    • It gets a huge dual-pane panoramic sunroof to make the cabin feel more airy.
    • It gets a sleek and clean steering wheel with mounted controls.

    Kia Seltos Practicality and Storage Space

    • Lots of storage space is present in Seltos' cabin, including cup holders in the centre console, a cooled glovebox, and bottle pockets in the doors.
    • For storage, it gets 447 litres of boot space, which will be expandable via its foldable 60-40 split rear seats.
    Read More

    Kia Seltos Safety

    • It scored a five-star BNCAP crash safety rating in both adult and child occupant protection.
    • Safety features six airbags, ABS with EBD, hill hold assist, an electronic parking brake (EPB), and a tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS).
    • The new Kia Seltos gets a 360-degree camera and a Level 2 ADAS system with 28 features, including front collision avoidance assist, adaptive cruise control, blind view monitor, highway driving assist, and more driver assist features.
    • Its seats also come equipped with ISOFIX child seat mount anchors.

    FAQs About Kia Seltos

    Price
    Q: What is the on-road price of Kia Seltos base model?
    The on-road price of Kia Seltos base model in Mumbai is Rs. 13.38 Lakh, which includes registration (RTO) charges of Rs. 1.46 Lakh, insurance of Rs. 55,422 and other charges of Rs. 500.
    Q: What is the on-road price of Kia Seltos top model?
    The on-road price of Kia Seltos top model in Mumbai is Rs. 26.69 Lakh, which includes registration (RTO) charges of Rs. 3.49 Lakh, insurance of Rs. 95,058 and other charges of Rs. 500.
    Performance
    Q: What is the real world mileage of Kia Seltos?
    The CarWale expert's tested mileage of Kia Seltos is 10.7 kmpl in city and 16.65 kmpl on highways. As per users, the mileage came to be 17 kmpl in the real world.
    Specifications
    Q: What is the seating capacity in Kia Seltos?
    Kia Seltos is a 5 seater car.
    Q: What are the dimensions of Kia Seltos?
    The dimensions of Kia Seltos include its length of 4460 mm, width of 1830 mm and height of 1635 mm. The wheelbase of the Kia Seltos is 2690 mm.
    Features
    Q: Is Kia Seltos available in 4x4 variant?
    No, Kia Seltos doesn't come with four wheel drive option.
    Safety
    Q: How many airbags does Kia Seltos get?
    The top Model of Kia Seltos has 6 airbags. The Seltos has driver, front passenger, 2 curtain, driver side and front passenger side airbags.
    Q: Does Kia Seltos get ABS?
    Yes, all variants of Kia Seltos have ABS. ABS is a great accident prevention technology, allowing drivers to steer while braking hard.
